partners.subtitle: Build and develop an entrepreneurial ecosystem in your territory
partners.desc: BNE supports entrepreneurs, business leaders and economic networks in creating high-value connections between territories.
partners.descP2: We believe that the greatest projects emerge when the right people, the right expertise and the right opportunities come together.
partners.descP3: That is why we are developing a network of local partners capable of bringing the BNE spirit to life in their region, country or ecosystem.
partners.descP4: Becoming a BNE partner means contributing to building bridges between entrepreneurs, territories and international opportunities.

section1.title: A territorial partner role
section1.desc: Our partners are the local ambassadors of the BNE ecosystem in their territory.
section1.descP2: Like our local representatives, they participate in building and developing BNE dynamics by bringing their knowledge of the field, their network and their ability to connect economic players.
section1.card1: Identify entrepreneurs, business leaders and economic players in your territory.
section1.card3: Participate in organizing BNE immersions and events.
section1.card4: Create connections between your territory and other BNE ecosystems.

section2.title: What the BNE partnership brings you
section2.card1Desc: You become an identified player in the entrepreneurial ecosystem of your territory. You benefit from visibility among an international network of leaders, entrepreneurs and partners committed to openness and development.
section2.card2Desc: BNE meetings naturally create opportunities. By connecting entrepreneurs and business leaders, you develop your network, strengthen your local influence and can identify new collaborations or opportunities for your own business.
section2.card3Desc: BNE builds bridges between territories. By joining the ecosystem, you access an international dynamic bringing together entrepreneurs and partners from different horizons: Europe, Africa, North America and other developing territories.
section2.card4Desc: A BNE partnership is not just a commercial relationship. It is a collaboration based on trust, contribution and reciprocal value creation. Each partner brings their expertise, network and knowledge of the territory to build a stronger ecosystem together.

section3.title: Partners committed to their territory
section3.desc: Every territory has its own strengths, talents and opportunities.
section3.descP2: The role of BNE is to create the framework that allows these resources to connect and grow.
section3.descP3: Our partners thus become essential players in creating new economic, entrepreneurial and human connections.

section4.title: How to become a BNE partner?
section4.desc: We first discuss with you to understand your territory, your network and your ambitions.
section4.descP2: Together, we define the best way to build a BNE dynamic adapted to your environment.
section4.step1: Discovery meeting with the BNE team.
section4.step2: Analysis of opportunities in your territory.
section4.step3: Definition of the role and collaboration model.

sectionFinal.title: Do you want to become a key player in the entrepreneurial development of your territory?
sectionFinal.desc: Contact the BNE team and let's discuss collaboration opportunities.
